style.bg: Vox-style editorial paper collage background plate, top-down flat lay on an aged cream-beige paper desk (#E8DCC4), subtle paper fibers, faint creases, risograph grain, muted palette of beige paper, ink black, a touch of signal red #C8312B, teal #2F6F6A and mustard #D9A441.
style.bg_tail: Keep the CENTER and most of the frame calm, empty paper for later overlays; decorative elements only near the edges and corners. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no people. 16:9 landscape. Save it as a PNG.
style.cut: A single black-and-white halftone newspaper-print style cutout (photocopy contrast, visible halftone dots, slight risograph grain), cut out with a 8px uneven off-white paper border like a scissor-cut sticker,
style.cut_tail: on a PURE FLAT SOLID GREEN #00FF00 background, no shadow on the background, centered with generous green margin, nothing else in the image, no readable text, no letters, no watermark. Save it as a PNG.
